evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Norwegen: Norvegia
Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Nortvegia: Nortvegia, Nortwegia, Nortveja, Norwegen
terms.comment: A country takes a preposition: in Norvegiam (to), in Norvegiā (in), ē Norvegiā (from).

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).
